name: The Curious Visitor
summary: After the Stockade uprising, Warden Thelwater has found a troubling link to Bazil Thredd. For months before the riot, a man called Maelik visited Thredd with papers that passed inspection.

sections.title: A Breach in Protocol
sections.body: After the riot, Warden Thelwater learned that Bazil Thredd’s former comrades had not abandoned him. For months, a quiet visitor met with Thredd once or twice a week. He passed every inspection, carried authorized papers, and gave his name as Maelik. Thelwater suspects those visits helped coordinate the bloody uprising. He sends you to City Architect Baros Alexston with a description, hoping to learn who the visitor was.

sections.title: Ties to the Stonemasons
sections.body: Before their rebellion, Baros Alexston worked closely with Edwin VanCleef and the Stonemasons Guild. Maelik’s name means nothing to him, and the description might fit countless former craftsmen. Yet the visitor had valid clearance to enter the Stockade. That points beyond criminals slipping past guards: Defias sympathizers and agents remain deeply rooted in Stormwind’s civic offices.

faq.q: Who is the curious visitor mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: The visitor gave his name as Maelik. For months before the Stockade riot, he visited Bazil Thredd once or twice a week with papers that appeared legitimate.

faq.q: Why does Warden Thelwater send you to Baros Alexston?
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater sends you to Baros Alexston, Stormwind’s City Architect, who once worked alongside Edwin VanCleef and the Stonemasons Guild. Since the Defias began among the Stonemasons, Thelwater hopes Alexston’s former guild ties may help him recognize the visitor.

faq.q: How did Maelik enter the Stockade without being caught?
faq.answer: Maelik entered the Stockade with legitimate papers that cleared prison security checks. The guards had no legal cause to refuse him, suggesting either a bureaucratic error or corrupt officials within the kingdom’s administration.

faq.q: What role did Bazil Thredd play in the prison riots?
faq.answer: Bazil Thredd was an imprisoned leader of the Defias Brotherhood in the Stockade. He organized and led the inmates’ violent uprising, likely coordinating it through his visits with Maelik.

faq.q: What happens after Baros Alexston reads the description?
faq.answer: Baros Alexston recognizes neither the name Maelik nor Thelwater’s description. He agrees to investigate further, since the visitor must have connections in the city.

faq.q: Why is the visitor important to the investigation of the Defias?
faq.answer: The regular visits show that the Stockade riot was a planned Defias plot, not a spontaneous outburst of lawless rage. Someone with high-level access to Stormwind’s official papers helped make it possible.

angles.text: As a human, you can see how forged or sanctioned entry papers reveal deep weaknesses and possible corruption in the Kingdom of Stormwind’s government.
As an Alliance member, you know finding Bazil Thredd’s mysterious contact matters if Defias sympathizers are to be rooted out of the capital.
As a rogue, you recognize the skill it takes to pass every prison inspection with proper papers.
